title: Length of Active Duty Coverage and the TRICARE Reserve Select Early-Duty Month Credit
content:
**Training questions - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

**Rule.** Active duty days count toward the early-duty month credit only as the length of that coverage allows: where the active duty enrollment shows its coverage running more than 30 days from its effective date, those days count from the enrollment's effective date; where it shows its coverage running 30 days or fewer, no day counts; otherwise days count only after the plan's termination date.

**What is "the active duty enrollment"?** The purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment, applied or active.

**How is the length read?** As the number of days from the enrollment's effective date to the coverage end date its TRICARE Prime record shows (its disenrollment date).

**What falls under "otherwise"?** No applied or active TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment, or one whose record shows no coverage end date.

**What do the three outcomes mean for the month?** More than 30 days: no day before the enrollment's effective date counts. 30 days or fewer: no day of the month counts. Otherwise: no day on or before the plan's termination date counts.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, effective date 10 June)

| Coverage end shown | Days from effective date to end | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 10 July | 30 | no day counts |
| 11 July | 31 | days count from 10 June |
| none shown | - | days count only after the plan's termination date |
